title: Design one shared spatial-index epoch for all consumers
requires: Any development host; access to current API, schedule and qualification records
scope: Inventory current broad phases and design the shared dynamic BVH, its leaf/query contracts and one-update tick lifecycle. Do not assume liquid sorted grids already share rigid mesh BVHs. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Map rigid N-squared pair filtering, liquid per-population/per-edge sorts, deformable surface refits and smoke collision lookups to shared bounds/build/traversal primitives; retain static mesh trees and regular-grid field operators where appropriate.
Define generation-tagged identities, active counts, particle radius and swept rigid/deformable queries, deterministic ownership and bounded scratch/overflow behavior.

Specify conservative full-tick translation/rotation/solver-correction bounds and candidate completeness tests, with explicit out-of-envelope failure behavior that never adds a hidden rebuild or substep.
Specify one mutation/admission phase for emission/removal/teleport/topology changes, then one dynamic index publication reused by all domains and edges; record per-consumer migration interfaces.
evidence: PASS: docs/roadmap/F8-05-SHARED-SPATIAL-INDEX.md sections 1-3 and 6-8 map inspected main f8f7c52 source paths to shared bounds/build/query interfaces, cached mesh trees, retained grid operators, generation identities and bounded GPU-active work.

PASS: sections 4-7 define translation/rotation/total-correction candidate inclusion, one private update and publication, provisional births, atomic phase-transfer fallback, and tick rejection without hidden rebuilds/substeps.

PASS: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/roadmap -p test_*.py; Linux host Python 3.11.2 CPU model; 55 tests (35 lease/workflow plus 20 tests in tests/roadmap/test_f8_spatial_design.py) on synchronized main bdf66c1. Includes randomized candidate inclusion, endpoint-rotation negative control, signed bindings, tombstones, capacity/overflow and no partial commit.

LIMIT: design/model only, no GPU kernels or device timing/physical qualification. F8-00 must approve concrete motion/correction budgets and admission/phase timing tradeoffs; F8-03 and F8-06 through F8-21 implement and qualify the contracts. Model covers one-to-one transfers, not multi-particle conversion physics.
